Gives back one of the 6 clip planes of a camera, as set with [SetCameraClipPlane](SetCameraClipPlane). Whether the plane is on is given by [GetCameraClipPlaneEnabled](GetCameraClipPlaneEnabled). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@param index  Which plane, from 0 to 5.
@returns A FloatVector4 with a, b, c and d of the plane. A plane that was never set is all 0.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraClipPlane camera, 2, 0, 1, 0, -1
Local plane:FloatVector4 = GetCameraClipPlane(camera, 2)
Print plane[0] + " " + plane[1] + " " + plane[2] + " " + plane[3]
WaitKey
```
